annotations.title: Read the text of a filing

description: Return the text of one filing in a saved case — a complaint, a motion, an order, an exhibit — as the court archive extracted it from the PDF, so you can read, quote and explain what the document actually says rather than only its docket title. Takes a document_id from get_case_docket. Long documents come in parts: pass the returned next_offset to read on. When a document has no text (a scanned page nobody has run OCR on, or a copy only the court holds), the result says so and gives the PDF link if there is one; never guess at what an unread document says.

document_id.description: The document_id of a document listed by get_case_docket.

matter_id.description: The CaseMagic matter id, as returned by create_case_passport or shown in an earlier result. Omit it when the account follows exactly one case and that is the one meant.

offset.description: Where to start reading, in characters. Defaults to 0.

name: read_case_document

error.description: Present only when the call failed: a code, a message and, where there is one, an action such as a link to give the user.

code.description: Machine-readable error code, for example CASE_NOT_FOUND or MULTIPLE_CASES_FOUND.

message.description: What went wrong, in a sentence.

next_offset.description: Where the next slice starts, or null at the end.

text.description: The text, or null when the archive holds none.

title: Read the text of a filing
